exclusion_reason: No corpus acquisition or guest runtime exists to execute.
promotion_trigger: Promote when every corpus binary yields a reproducible run record with stage and generic-gap classification.
expected_failing_assertion: No corpus binary can be executed end to end.
active_gate_evidence: The ingest path classifies and packages without executing, and the bounded probe runs a declared subset only.
procedure: Run each corpus binary through the real ingest and run path.
Record the reached stage per binary.
Classify each failure into a named generic gap that maps to a roadmap item.
pass_criterion: Every binary yields a reproducible record.
Failure maps to a generic gap, never a title patch.
